deployments_detail.use: WEG Motor Specialist using AI and machine learning to diagnose, monitor and provide predictive maintenance for electric motors
WEG Motor Specialist: AI/ML engine (module of Motion Fleet Management) that autonomously diagnoses, monitors and recommends predictive maintenance on electric motors from sensor data [WEG (in-house)]
WEGvision.AI: computer-vision software that uses RTSP/security cameras to monitor production processes, detect anomalies and turn video into operational decisions [WEG (Mvisia)]

Acquisition and integration of Mvisia, a computer-vision/AI startup, providing machine-vision algorithms for industrial quality inspection and process monitoring (now WEG Computer Vision Systems) [Mvisia (acquired by WEG)]
AI-based predictive maintenance for wind turbines: solution communicates in real time with turbines and detects potential maintenance needs in advance [WEG (in-house)]
Automated smart lubrication system combining IoT and AI to manage lubrication of industrial assets (recognized in the Inovativos 2025 award) [WEG (in-house)]
WEG Smart Vision Sensor: edge device with embedded AI that performs precise automated industrial inspections in complex environments [WEG (Mvisia)]
PC-Factory MES 4.0 IoT platform with AI algorithms for anomaly detection, failure prediction and self-tuning of machines and processes [WEG (in-house)]

WEG Smart Sensors deployed at a copper mine in Western Australia: IoT/predictive-maintenance monitoring detected critical failure risk in a SAG mill motor, enabling planned maintenance and avoiding unplanned downtime [WEG (in-house)]

WEG Motion Fleet Management deployed for water utilities: cloud predictive-maintenance solution with AI Specialist modules for autonomous fault diagnosis of pumps/motors/drives in water assets [WEG (in-house)]
KaizenWEG global continuous-improvement platform rebuilt with low-code and AI to manage and scale employee-driven kaizens across the company [WEG (in-house, low-code + AI)]
WEG Mobile Robot (WMR): autonomous mobile robot (AMR) using natural/contour navigation for intralogistics and internal material transport in factories [WEG (in-house)]
